Wj.bar_b_note: A functional but bare dark panel with no teal interaction or gold progression accents and (on B) tiny clipped text sits well below Palworld's HUD hierarchy and finish.

Am.bar_b_note: The grass and sky are serviceable, but a lone free-standing wall piece beside a flat-shaded low-poly boulder against a painted mountain backdrop reads as a prototype rather than a lived-in Palworld-class base.

Tk.bar_b_note: The naturalistic bear model and fur sit at the owner's Stormursa bar, though the storm arcs are the weak link (purple patches on A, near-invisible on B).

Cy.bar_b_note: A clear, warm, stylised elder with readable face and eyes and a meadow-green palette fits a Palworld-class cozy cast, held back only by plain clothing material detail.

Ie.bar_b_note: The dark spiny mole reads as a hedgehog-like lump with only faint blue streaks, missing the bright arcs and fur detail that make the Thundertunnel board and the owner bar pop.

No.bar_b_note: Side A's dark navy wolf holds the owner's Tanglevolt bar in the standing and hit frames, but both sides' faint poses collapse into a pale belly-up slab that breaks the read.

Kt.bar_b_note: A's naturalistic fur is let down by a blotchy yellow leopard pattern and a floating faint-mid frame, and B is a smooth clay-toy pig, so neither reaches Palworld finish or the owner's naturalistic bar.

Ws.bar_b_note: The bear model reaches the owner's Stormursa naturalism, but the arcs read as purple paint patches on A and fade to dull lines on B, so the storm identity doesn't pop.

top_changes.change: Re-author the storm-arc material on the storm creatures (bear Tk/Ws, mole Ie, wolf No): thin, bright white-violet emissive arcs with a tight bloom over a darker, desaturated coat, instead of purple painted patches, faint blue streaks or a lavender wash.

Build the homestead wall as a real piece: visible plank/post thickness, darker weathered wattle or plank infill instead of the pale flat panel, a capped top and a stone footing set into the ground, designed to tile into a run of wall rather than standing alone like a door.

Replace the Kt boar with a naturalistic boar at the owner bar (real bristle fur in a coherent brown palette, tusks, standing taller than the 1.80 m trainer) and ground its faint poses; drop the clay-toy B version.
